notes.title: June Final Patch, Prep for July Tourney
notes.notes:
Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.7b
Minor fixes to make sure Linux and Windows are on a fully synchronized codebase, and prep for the July tourney.

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/161b9118fabc97407c33c522747ff14217cf35f8.png

Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.7a
Welcome to the June track! There's more than one route to victory on this month's track.

This is also our first Linux release! Please report any bugs promptly on the forum.
Please consider this Linux release to be a bit of a "beta" stage, while we continue to work out known issues with AMD cards.
We are working to resolve these, but we have spent quite a lot of time trying to track them down, and we felt it best to get this game in your hands sooner rather than later.

Enjoy the track!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/ce9ee518f691b08601ade99c4abbed89a7d900f0.png

notes.title: March Track Release
notes.notes:
Welcome, Master Chef of Alien Scumbags!
This patch brings in a little cross-promo with Alien Scumbags, and brings Master Chef's ship to join the spectators on some tracks.
March's track 12 is now here and ready for people to check out and enjoy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/7630f1b936e8aefd2c4db8cbbe65450140ba7cbe.png

You can check out Alien Scumbags here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252410/Alien_Scumbags/

And you'll see why Master Chef needed a little R&R after fighting off wave after wave of enemies in this great little pixel art shooter by Monster Finger Games.

Keep an eye out for Master Chef's ship as you race around, and we hope you have a blast with the March track!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/87bbd17d895df081558131506a8ecc81d1f967f1.png
